deathSays.line: Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The quills make excellent awls. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
The keeper of Emberhold's codex watches you copy the final page. "You're the first outsider to read it all," they say quietly. "Our dead wrote some of that. Carry it well."
🕯️ Patrick is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
🕯️ Patrick Hao is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Patrick kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
That night, they bring Patrick home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"

🔥 The fire settles. Nina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Carol asks "And you're still standing." Naran says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.
The kite stops dead. Below it, the ground lights up in a grid.
💥 The square SCREAMS — static made solid.

tableLines.line: ⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Theo speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

⬢ SYSTEM: "One clarification, scholar: linking codices sharpens MY eyes. Ability slots grow from YOUR neural integration — 25/100, holding 2 slots (next at 40). Discover, practice, survive — let the interface learn you."

With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
Laurent wanders over, just to talk. "You hear what Carol said about the creek? ...Never mind. How are you holding up?"
🖐️ Its hands blur — and suddenly it's holding your Hand Saw! It's already running.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
A kite over the treeline. Nobody is holding the string. On its screen, for a frame: you, from above.
You don't know what that was. A kite with no string, holding station over the trees. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Tashi: "Death Cap is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
James: "Muscadine Grapes is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

🍖 THE BUNDLE — six different gifts on one table (garden harvest, foraged feast, preserved food, a guest of honor, a kept recipe, a donated keepsake-channel). The village did not just eat — it showed what it can do. (+4 ladder points to the climb.)
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 13,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
🖐️ Its hands blur — and suddenly it's holding your Hardlight knife! It's already running.
